question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s firm grip on the Chinese Communist Party, state presidency, and Central Military Commission underpins trader consensus that he will remain in power through the end of 2026. After securing a third term at the 20th Party Congress in 2022 and abolishing presidential term limits, Xi has maintained control through extensive anti-corruption purges of senior officials and military leaders, with no designated successor or open factional challenge visible ahead of the 21st Party Congress expected in 2027. Recent public appearances and policy statements through mid-2026 show no signs of health issues or internal moves that would trigger removal. While sudden medical events, elite intrigue, or unforeseen crises could theoretically alter outcomes in this short window, the absence of credible signals for near-term leadership change sustains the strong market pricing on continuity.
